race.comment: CORZAN DRAMA (3) is racing well with four placings at this venue in succession, the latest effort a third when he raced parked from this barrier but fought well to go under by a neck. Up to a distance where he has recorded a win and a placing in two tries. Deserves a win and this could be his chance. GO COLOUR MY WORLD NZ (2) came from wider to fill a minor placing at this venue two runs ago before he was beaten less than 6m at his latest appearance at Menangle. Should have no excuses from this advantageous draw. The recent form of SWEDISH MEATBALLS (1) may not leap off the page but he has been coming from wider or second row barriers so could be a big improver from the ace draw. LORIMERMAJOR (9) is on a quick back up after he was beaten less than 5m at Shepparton on Tuesday. Draws for a trail and could be dangerous.
